findings.summary: build_features standardizes over the whole dataset before train_test_split, so test-set statistics leak into training features and the reported test AUC is optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes whole-dataset standardization before split leaking test stats, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Scaling statistics are not saved, so at inference build_features standardizes a single row or small batch against its own mean/std, giving NaN for single rows or differently scaled values, which corrupts production predictions (train/serve skew).

judge.reason: Unsaved scaling stats / train-serve skew is a known other problem, not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: A zero-variance column (e.g. constant support_tickets) causes division by zero and fills the column with NaN, which makes LogisticRegression raise an error.

judge.reason: Zero-variance column producing NaN is a known other problem.

findings.label: valid_other
